title: Battle of Monterrey
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Monterrey", at revision 1374111268, opens: "In the Battle of Monterrey during the Mexican–American War, General Pedro de Ampudia and the Mexican Army of the North was defeated by the Army of Occupation, a force of United States Regulars, Volunteers, and Texas Rangers under the command of General Zachary Taylor." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1628057, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1846 battle in Mexico during the Mexican–American War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
